scenarios.name: Report an unevaluable model-state parameter equation

scenario_steps.name: The MCAD Software has a model-state table containing the length parameter d0
no parameter named abc exists in the part
the user replaces the active member d0 value with "abc" and presses Enter
the d0 cell displays "abc" with a yellow background
the yellow d0 cell remains visible
a message reports an error in the table and identifies the unevaluable d0 equation "abc"
the model-state table remains open with "abc" in the d0 cell
the table closes without accepting the entry
